descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-04 Data Retention · S28 Deleting a Nursing Home resident: gone from the database at once, audit trail kept

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T5 Deleting a patient hard-deletes all of their data immediately (backups per OAT-04), and the audit log is kept. (TFA-94699 AC 4; UAT TC-24 Expected 5; TFA-92568 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress; TFA-92568 in progress
  • U1 Deletion is a hard delete, not a hidden flag: every record that clears (at its window, or when a patient or account is deleted) is gone from the database, queryable as gone, and is not merely hidden … (UAT OAT-04; UAT OAT-04 step 2; TFA-94699 AC 1; TFA-92568 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress; TFA-92568 in progress
  • T8 Every delete asks for confirmation once and there is no bulk delete. Tested in TC-24 (U7-U9); here only: each patient or resident delete in S06 / S28 asks exactly once. (TFA-94699 AC 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Fresh physician (make-session fixture) with the resident {snfResident} and a second control resident {snfControl} who is not in today's visits

When Open All Residents, remove {snfResident} with its remove control and accept the confirmation once

Then The confirmation is asked exactly once; the resident's document and list row are gone from the database at once; the audit log keeps every earlier row plus one op=delete row; {snfControl} is untouched

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): TFA-94699 AC 4, TC-24 Expected 5 and 3.3: the verdict needs the backend reads (document gone, not flagged; list row gone; audit rows kept). The All Residents snapshot must contain {snfControl} (only All Residents lists a resident who is not in today's visits; both tabs share /snf) and must not contain {snfResident}. More than one confirmation, or none = Fail (TFA-94699 AC 6). …

Where it ran: local probes (multi-device probes); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S28 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane probes.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: probes.

UAT item: OAT-04 Data Retention · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-04/S28

Deleting a Nursing Home resident: gone from the database at once, audit trail kept

Tickets: TFA-92568 Phase 4: Make it safe for real patients (in progress); TFA-94699 Data Retention & Purge (in progress)

New local lane probes: status blocked in probes/results.json → blocked (blocked).

How it is tested (probes/plan.json, automatable: yes): Scripted probe: All Residents, look for a remove control on the resident card (or its chart); if present: remove, one confirm, admin reads (doc null, snfResidentList row gone, audit kept + op=delete, control untouched); if absent: recorded as Blocked (known: no NH remove on main, TC-25 Q3). [Review 2026-10-14] Control match tightened (a button naming this resident, or a resident-level Remove/Delete on the chart); chart path handled; skips itself while no control exists (Blocked, known). Pre-evidence: snf:remove called directly — document gone, list row gone, audit kept + op=delete. — Same machinery as S06; the oracle itself says no remove control = Blocked, known.

Detail:

Re-checked after review 2026-10-14 (18:00 JST runs: fix-*.json). Known: no remove control for a Nursing Home resident on main, on the All Residents card or on the chart (control match tightened to a button naming this resident or a resident-level Remove / Delete; the chart path is now handled); the oracle rules this Blocked, known. The control resident and the target were both listed. Pre-evidence only (never the verdict): snf:remove (convex/snf.ts:240, which no screen calls) through the physician's own session on a second resident: document gone at the first read, list row gone, the earlier create + update audit rows kept, exactly one op=delete row, control untouched.

Known gap (known): TC-25 Q3

Evidence: 3 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — The verdict needs the removed resident's audit_logs rows (backend-read-admin, the local admin key); dev has no admin key, so this stays on the local stack (once backend-read-admin exists), and main has no resident remove control yet (K15).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
